text:
Hi,

I’m Tobias Reyne, a passionate and hard-working freelancer with 7 years of experience building clean, user-focused digital products. I’m interested in your SaaS platform branding project and would love to help create a logo and basic brand kit that feels modern, trustworthy, and polished for a customer engagement platform.

While my background is in product and full-stack development, I’ve worked closely with brand systems inside SaaS products and understand how important it is for the visual identity to feel consistent across sales, product, and marketing materials. Your platform sits in a competitive space alongside brands like Braze, Klaviyo, Unifonic, and MoEngage, so having a strong, professional identity will make a real difference in how you present the company to prospects and partners.

One relevant project I’ve worked on was Embedded customer analytics for a confidential B2B SaaS client. I built usage dashboards embedded directly into the product so each customer account could see its own metrics. That project rolled out to 140 customer accounts and was delivered 3 weeks early. It’s a good example of my experience working in SaaS environments where clarity, consistency, and user trust matter.

For your project, I can help shape a brand direction that works well across a logo, brand template, guideline, and a universal PowerPoint template for sales, pitching, and proposals. I’m comfortable thinking through how visual identity should support both product and business communication, and I can keep the brand system practical so it’s easy to apply across different use cases.

I’m collaborative, detail-oriented, and used to working in fast-moving startup environments. If you already have early ideas, I can help refine them; if not, I can help translate the positioning of your customer engagement platform into a cohesive visual foundation.

I’d be glad to discuss your vision and what kind of look and feel you want for the brand.
